reason: Recharge the cold packs to restore the transfer reserve; the powered freezer is the natural place for them.
expectation: The freezer will recharge the packs for another cold transfer.

alternatives.reason: Restarting propellant production also addresses a stated goal, but I chose the cold reserve first.

effect: The flight packs are reconditioned, so the cold reserve goal is complete and I can turn to the plant.
reaction: A straightforward, expected result; the flight label gives the reserve a destination.
reason: The only gameplay option supplies the plant restart controls, matching the remaining goal.
expectation: The plant will restart production using restored solar power, though I do not know whether anything else will be needed.

effect: The return plant is running and both reserve goals are complete; no further plant action was needed.
reaction: Reassuring to restore the return system, though the restart itself felt very quick.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the return plant made the storm's continuing cost concrete: production must replace propellant lost through boil-off.

leastWorthwhile.text: Recharging the packs was predictable and yielded only a renamed item and goal completion; I wanted a little more sense of the reserve being restored.

surprise.text: Nothing in the two results particularly surprised me; both followed their stated goals.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: the freezer and restart controls each clearly matched a goal, although there was little decision beyond their order.

continue.text: Yes, chiefly to see what happens with the body in the ice and its journey home; this short maintenance chapter alone did not offer much discovery.
